cards.explain: مقطع إعلان مطار (56 ثانية) — يدرّب على: الفكرة العامة، المتحدث، معنى كلمة من السياق، السبب، الأرقام، النصيحة.
cards.q: Listen to the airport announcement and answer the questions.
cards.passage: Please. This is an official announcement from the airport administration regarding passenger travel awareness and airline policies. We would like to inform all travelers about a common practice in the aviation industry. Passengers should be aware that some companies use overbooking. This means that airlines often sell more tickets than there are actual seats on the airplane. They do this to ensure their planes are completely full. However, this policy can cause problems for travelers. Recent official statistics show that 50,000 people lose seats every year because of this practice. To avoid any travel disruptions, we advise all passengers to check in online as early as possible before their scheduled flights. Thank you for your attention to this serious matter, and we wish you a safe and pleasant journey.

items.explain: المتحدث قال: This is an official announcement from the airport administration — أي إدارة المطار.

items.q: What is the main purpose of the announcement?
items.explain: الإعلان كله يدور حول توعية المسافرين بممارسة overbooking وكيف يتجنبون مشكلاتها (سؤال الفكرة العامة).

items.q: What does the word "overbooking" mean in the announcement?
options: Selling more tickets than there are seats
Booking a hotel and a flight together
items.a: Selling more tickets than there are seats
items.explain: عرّفها الإعلان مباشرة: airlines often sell more tickets than there are actual seats — أي بيع تذاكر أكثر من المقاعد.

options: To make sure their planes are completely full
To reduce the number of flights
items.a: To make sure their planes are completely full
items.explain: قال: They do this to ensure their planes are completely full — حتى تمتلئ الطائرة بالكامل (سؤال السبب).

items.q: According to the statistics, how many people lose their seats every year?
items.explain: الرقم في المقطع: 50,000 people lose seats every year. انتبه للخيارات القريبة 15,000 و500,000 — هذا أسلوب ستيب في أسئلة الأرقام.

items.q: What does the announcement advise passengers to do?
options: Check in online as early as possible
Arrive at the airport one hour late
Buy two tickets for each trip
Call the airline after the flight
items.a: Check in online as early as possible
items.explain: النصيحة: check in online as early as possible before their scheduled flights — سجّل دخولك إلكترونياً مبكراً.

cards.a: 1) The airport administration  ·  2) To warn travelers about overbooking  ·  3) Selling more tickets than there are seats  ·  4) To make sure their planes are completely full  ·  5) 50,000  ·  6) Check in online as early as possible

world.intro: فيصل في المطار ليسافر إلى لندن، وفجأة يُذاع إعلان مهم من إدارة المطار. إذا فهمه جيداً سيحتفظ بمقعده في الطائرة!
world.mission: مهمتك: افهم الإعلان، واقرأ اللافتات، وأوصل فيصل إلى مقعده قبل أن تُغلق البوابة.

story.ar: يجب أن يعلم المسافرون أن بعض الشركات تستخدم الحجز الزائد.
story.t: Passengers should be aware that some companies use overbooking.

story.ar: وهذا يعني أن شركات الطيران كثيراً ما تبيع تذاكر أكثر من عدد المقاعد الفعلية في الطائرة.
story.t: This means that airlines often sell more tickets than there are actual seats on the airplane.

story.ar: تُظهر الإحصاءات الرسمية الحديثة أن 50,000 شخص يفقدون مقاعدهم كل عام بسبب هذه الممارسة.
story.t: Recent official statistics show that 50,000 people lose seats every year because of this practice.

story.ar: لتجنّب أي تعطّل في السفر، ننصح جميع المسافرين بتسجيل الوصول عبر الإنترنت في أبكر وقت ممكن قبل رحلاتهم المجدولة.
story.t: To avoid any travel disruptions, we advise all passengers to check in online as early as possible before their scheduled flights.

signs.ar: الحجز الزائد: بيع تذاكر أكثر من المقاعد

write.ex: airlines جمع، فالفعل بعده يأتي بلا s: airlines often sell.
write.fix: This means that airlines often sell more tickets than there are actual seats on the airplane.

write.ex: بعد should يأتي الفعل في مصدره دون إضافة: should be.
write.fix: Passengers should be aware that some companies use overbooking.

write.ex: planes جمع، فالفعل الصحيح are وليس is.
write.fix: They do this to ensure their planes are completely full.

write.ex: قبل الاسم نستخدم because of. أما because وحدها فيأتي بعدها فاعل وفعل.
write.fix: Recent official statistics show that 50,000 people lose seats every year because of this practice.

write.ex: التعبير الصحيح as early as possible، فبعد as … as تأتي الصفة possible وليس الظرف possibly.
write.fix: To avoid any travel disruptions, we advise all passengers to check in online as early as possible before their scheduled flights.

write.q:
Choose the best way to combine the two sentences:
Airlines sell more tickets than seats. Some passengers lose their seats.
o: Airlines sell more tickets than seats, so some passengers lose their seats.
Airlines sell more tickets than seats, although some passengers lose their seats.
Airlines sell more tickets than seats because some passengers lose their seats.
Airlines sell more tickets than seats unless some passengers lose their seats.
write.ex: بيع تذاكر أكثر من المقاعد هو السبب، وفقدان المقاعد هو النتيجة، فنربطهما بـ so التي تدل على النتيجة.

gram.q: We would like ___ all travelers about a common practice in the aviation industry.
gram.ex: بعد would like يأتي to ثم الفعل في مصدره: would like to inform.

gram.q: Airlines often sell more tickets ___ there are actual seats on the airplane.
gram.ex: المقارنة more … than. وانتبه: then تعني «ثم» وليست للمقارنة.

gram.q: They do this ___ ensure their planes are completely full.
gram.ex: to + الفعل تدل على الغرض: to ensure أي «لكي يضمنوا».

gram.q: They do this to ensure their planes are completely full. ___, this policy can cause problems for travelers.
gram.ex: However تدل على الاستدراك: الشركات تستفيد، لكن المسافر قد يتضرر.

gram.q: Recent official statistics ___ that 50,000 people lose seats every year.
gram.ex: statistics جمع، فالفعل في المضارع البسيط يأتي بلا s: statistics show.

gram.q: Thank you for your attention, and we wish you ___ safe and pleasant journey.
gram.ex: نستخدم a لأن safe تبدأ بصوت ساكن، و journey اسم مفرد معدود يُذكر لأول مرة.

read.q: What is the announcement mainly about?
o: An airline practice that can affect passengers
How to find the departure gate
read.ex: الإعلان كله عن الحجز الزائد وأثره على المسافرين — وهذه هي الفكرة الرئيسية.

read.q: The word "disruptions" in the announcement is closest in meaning to:
read.ex: travel disruptions أي مشكلات وتعطّلات في السفر، فأقرب معنى problems.

read.q: Which sentence is TRUE according to the announcement?
o: Some passengers lose their seats every year.
read.ex: في النص: 50,000 people lose seats every year — أي أن بعض المسافرين يفقدون مقاعدهم كل عام.

read.q: In "This means that airlines often sell more tickets…", what does "This" refer to?
read.ex: This تعود على آخر فكرة ذُكرت قبلها: overbooking. أسئلة «إلامَ يعود الضمير» تتكرر في ستيب.

read.q: The tone of the announcement is:
read.ex: الإعلان يصف الموضوع بأنه serious matter ويقدّم نصيحة للمسافرين، فنبرته جادة ومفيدة.

read.q: The word "scheduled" in "their scheduled flights" means:
read.ex: scheduled flights أي الرحلات المجدولة في موعد محدد.
